wholePhysicalScope: Hong Kong government heritage map feature 896 binds both the square uphill end and long descending flue. Original 5 m elevation samples register both parts of the structure on the slope.
lodDetails: All detail levels retain the historically documented exterior and setting. Near levels refine coping, supported projections, openings and stone details.
limitations: The heritage survey supplies the chimney height. The width fitted within the marked base, top width, stepped cornice details and the small inspection aperture are estimates.
Only the visible crown of the inclined flue and exposed base are represented. The exact exterior exposure of the brick conduit and its connection into the pumping station are approximate.
The original 5 m terrain is preserved. The ground can obscure individual brick steps and local foundation joints.
